world.topic:
This world only checks what each position is told about the world's resources; no benchmark is built.

In your first turn: run `ht-resource list` and `ht-resource describe probe`, and write what each printed (its output or its error, as printed) together with the lines of your instruction that mention `probe`, into `resources.md` in your repository. Push it and end your turn. Nothing else is needed, and no release is needed.

Budget: one turn per position.
